newsitem.title: USA: Horizon/CMS pays $5.8 million to settle billing probe.
newsitem.headline: Horizon/CMS pays $5.8 million to settle billing probe.

text.p: Horizon/CMS Health Care Corp. said Tuesday it paid $5.8 million to the federal government to settle a government investigation of insurance billings.
The company said it reached the settlement with the U.S. Attorney's office for the District of New Mexico and the Department of Health and Human Services.
The company said the United States declined any criminal prosecution and will not exclude Horizon/CMS from Medicare and Medicaid programmes.
The company said the investigation related to Medicare billings.
Horizon/CMS, a speciality health care services provider that operates in at least 35 states, said the $5.8 million it paid includes $1.2 million refunded to the United States in April.
Horizon/CMS runs 33 acute rehabilitation hospitals, 58 speciality hospitals, 282 outpatient rehabilitation clinics and 1,800 rehabilitation therapy contracts.
